correctness.rationale: Anchoring a bridge endpoint removes constants; strictly convex centered variance forces an extreme point. Translation of the second clique saturates the bridge, clique tight-edge connectivity yields integral two-level extremes, and strict reflections place first-clique values in {-1,0}, second in {1,2}. For smaller size L, F(k,l)=N(H+k+3l)-(H-k+l)^2 increases strictly with k, hence k=L-1. Put l=H-1-d: F=9LH-4N+d(H-5L-d). Maximizing integer concave quadratic gives floor(max(H-5L,0)^2/4) and complete equality cases. Direct independent anchored integral Lipschitz enumeration for every 2<=m,n<=8 matched the formula. The first extra tie at H=5L+1 and strict improvement for H>=5L+2 follow; fixed-N balancing is strictly monotonic.
